acceptance_criteria.statement: A persistent restart-safe supervisor autonomously executes intake, verified modeling, genuine missing-work selection, context, routing, dispatch, verification, and next-work continuation.

definition_of_done: Supervisor state is durable and idempotent.
Next ready work is selected without a human driving the session.
description: Compose existing foundations behind one persistent Autonomy Runtime supervisor and service entry point.
exclusions: A command responder, chat UI, or sequential component test is insufficient.
objective: Compose the persistent intake-to-next-work autonomy supervisor
observability_impact: Publish durable operation, cycle, task, worker, and continuation state.
rationale: Existing subsystem libraries do not constitute the continuously operating product.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Version supervisor state and retain replay-safe rollback to the prior cycle checkpoint.
scope: Persistent supervisor composition and automatic continuation
security_impact: Centralizes bounded authority without allowing the Director to bypass deterministic policy.
title: Persistent intake-to-next-work autonomy supervisor
